title: Stuffed Hasselback Turkey Breast
description: Chef John's stuffed Hasselback turkey breast is quicker than a whole bird. This recipe relies on typical stuffing ingredients to nestle into the sliced breast.
ingredients: 1 teaspoon poultry seasoning (dried sage, rosemary, and thyme)
1 pinch ground pepper, or to taste
1 pinch cayenne pepper, or to taste
1 (2 1/2 to 3 pound) turkey breast half (with bones and skin)
salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Melt 1 tablespoon butter in a skillet over medium heat. Add onion and celery; cook and stir until golden brown, about 6 minutes. Transfer to a bowl.

Add bread cubes, poultry seasoning, salt, and black pepper to onion mixture. Stir in chicken broth until thoroughly combined; rest to allow broth to absorb into the stuffing, about 15 minutes. Stir in egg yolk until evenly incorporated.
Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper.

Slice turkey breast crosswise down to the bone (do not cut through the bone) in 3/4-inch slices. Divide stuffing mixture among spaces between the slices. Place turkey breast on the prepared baking sheet. Brush with 1 tablespoon melted butter.

Roast in the preheated oven until richly browned, 60 to 75 minutes. An instant-read thermometer inserted near but not touching the bone should read 150 degrees F (65 degrees C). Remove from oven and let rest 10 minutes before slicing sections from bone.

video.description: Put your poultry in motion and try this surprisingly moist and flavorful hasselback technique on your turkey bird! Make stuffing with small bread cubes, sage or poultry seasoning, onions and celery cooked in butter, salt, pepper, cayenne, chicken broth and egg yolk. After slicing the turkey, season and fill each slice with stuffing, season, brush with butter and bake. The results are beautifully golden, juicy and incredibly delicious . . . a great choice if you have just a few around for the holidays and don’t desire baking an entire bird!
